Rain sat up in his chair, excitedly. ""Can I try one?""
Steppe, tired of his daily questions relented, ""Fine. But if my master finds out, I am done for."" He handed a potion to Rain.

	""What does it do?"" Rain asked.

雷恩兴奋地从椅子上直起身子。「我能试一瓶吗？」
斯泰普被他日复一日的追问磨烦了，让步道：「行吧。但要是我师父知道了，我就完了。」他把一瓶药水递给雷恩。

	「它是做什么的？」雷恩问。
res#60477/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Start

Steppe shrugged, ""I'm not sure. I sometimes forget to label them.""

	Rain squinted his eyes and leaned in towards the potion. ""It says Excitement."" he said softly. ""That sounds good to me."" 

	Steppe's hand was already reaching out to stop him when Rain chugged the entire bottle. He sighed, ""You know you're only supposed to have some of it, right?""
Rain shrugged.

斯泰普耸耸肩：「不清楚。我有时候忘了贴标签。」

	雷恩眯起眼凑近药瓶。「上面写着『兴奋』。」他轻声念道，「听起来不错。」

	斯泰普的手才伸出去要拦，雷恩已经仰头把整瓶灌了下去。他叹气道：「你知道这玩意儿只能喝一点的，对吧？」
雷恩耸了耸肩。
res#60477/whatIHaveToSay[2]
Start

""Whatever. Imagine something exciting you would like to see.""

	Rain thought pensively, then blurted out, "I want to experience the most exciting moment in the life of the world's best archer!"

	""Elaborate. I will give you that. Let's hope I didn't mix up some of the ingredients. I wouldn't want you to explode.""

「随你。想象一件你渴望目睹的刺激场面吧。」

	雷恩沉思片刻，脱口而出：「我想体验史上最强弓手一生中最刺激的一刻！」

	「花样不少，这点我服。但愿我没把哪味原料配错——我可不想你炸开花。」
res#60477/whatIHaveToSay[3]
Start

Rain's eyes swelled for a moment, unsure if Steppe was joking. Then he lost consciousness. He woke, with the wind whipping through his hair. His insides felt like they were doing somersaults, and his vision was blurry. Confusion turned to panic, as he realized where he was.

	He was falling. Above him, clouds floated along softly, and large winged creatures were darting about.

雷恩瞪大了眼睛，不确定斯泰普是不是在开玩笑。随即他失去了意识。再醒来时，狂风抽打着他的头发，内脏像在翻筋斗，视线模糊。当他意识到自己身在何处，困惑变成了惊恐。

	他在坠落。头顶的云缓缓浮动，巨大的有翼生物往来穿梭。
res#60477/whatIHaveToSay[4]
Start

Arrows and fire zipped about him. He spun to face the ground, and found he had a long way to go.

	Terror surged through him, but he could feel a calm not his own; a sureness that did not come from his own mind. He realized that he did not control this body, but it felt like he did. It wasn't quite like a memory, but Rain couldn't think of any comparable experience he'd ever had.

箭矢与火焰在他四周呼啸。他翻身面向地面，发现落差还长得很。

	恐惧涌遍全身，但他感到一种不属于自己的冷静——一种并非生自他心底的笃定。他意识到这具身体不由他掌控，感觉却又像由他掌控。这不完全像一段记忆，而雷恩想不出自己有过任何类似的经历。
res#60477/whatIHaveToSay[5]
Start

""Find the Mark"", he heard in his mind, in a voice not his own. His eyes shifted rapidly, until they came to rest on something below him. He was hurtling towards a large winged beast hundreds of feet below.

	He felt his hands tense around his bow, an arrow already nocked and at the ready. If he didn't do something he was going to smash into it. Without warning his body shifted. Legs, arms and torso twisting about. He was steering himself.

「找到准星。」一个不属于他的声音在他脑中响起。他的目光飞速移动，最终落在下方某处——他正朝脚下数百尺处一头巨大的有翼巨兽坠去。

	他感到双手在弓上收紧，一支箭已经搭好，蓄势待发。再不动作，他就要撞上去了。毫无预兆地，他的身体一变——腿、臂、躯干拧转起来。他在操纵自己。
res#60477/whatIHaveToSay[6]
Start

The creature's back was peppered with arrows and scorch marks, and a rider in full plate mail held tight to its reins. The creature looked up, but Rain sailed past it at lightning speed. A moment afterwards, he felt the string loose, and the arrow flew. Up it went, towards its mark, with speed and accuracy he could previously only have dreamt of.

	The arrow pierced the underside of the wing joint, and nothing happened for a moment.

巨兽的背脊扎满箭矢与灼痕，一名全身板甲的骑手紧紧抓着缰绳。巨兽抬起头，可雷恩已电光石火般掠过它的身侧。下一刻，他感到弓弦一松，箭飞了出去——向着它的目标，带着他从前的梦中都不敢奢望的速度与准头。

	箭头洞穿了翼关节的下侧。有一瞬，什么也没有发生。
res#60477/whatIHaveToSay[7]
Start

Then, without warning, the bone snapped, unable to support the tension of the wind. The creature screamed and the rider was thrown from its back. All three plummeted to the ground. The creature spun wildly, but Rain was steady. He felt himself smile. His heart pounded. Then his eyes pressed shut.

	Rain woke with a thrash, fell to the floor from his chair and coughed up the remaining drops of potion.

然后，毫无预兆地，那根骨头断了——它撑不住风中的张力。巨兽发出惨叫，骑手被甩离鞍背。三者一齐坠向地面。巨兽疯狂旋转，雷恩却稳如磐石。他感到自己在微笑，心脏狂跳。然后，他闭上了眼睛。

	雷恩猛然惊醒，从椅子上跌落到地板，咳出了剩下的几滴药水。
res#60477/whatIHaveToSay[8]
Start

Steppe cackled above him, ""I guess it didn't work. That will teach you to mess with me during my studies. Now get along brother. I have lots to learn.""

	Rain stood, and wobbled, uneasy on his legs. He didn't look Steppe in the eyes. He just walked to the door and shut it behind him. He wasn't sure what to make of the experience. Was it all in his head? He guessed it didn't matter since the experience was real. It was decided then.

斯泰普在他头顶咯咯直笑：「看来没成。这就是你在我研习时捣乱的下场。行了，走吧兄弟，我还有很多要学。」

	雷恩站起来，双腿发软，摇晃不定。他没看斯泰普的眼睛，只是走到门口，把门带上。他不知该如何理解这段经历——难道全是他脑中的幻象？他想，那也不重要了，因为体验本身真切无比。就在那时，他下定了决心。
res#60477/whatIHaveToSay[9]
Start

He would no longer pursue archery. He would write a book, and he had the first creature ready for entry into Rain's Bestiary of Fantastic Creatures.

The story as told by Rain Bloth, to his son Urmias. May his memory live on in this story.

他不再练箭了。他要写一本书——而他的「奇异生物志」已经有第一个条目可以落笔。

这个故事由雷恩·布洛斯讲给他的儿子厄米亚斯。愿他的记忆在这故事中长存。
